messages:
alex: Heads up — SIEM spike: multiple service-account role assignments in us-west-2 over the last 6m. rule id = SVR-7123
sec-bot: Detection SVR-7123 triggered 78 events in 5m. Query: `event.type:iam AND action:AttachRolePolicy AND src.principal_type:ServiceAccount` — top principals: svc-build-*, svc-nerf-ops
maria: Is this from CI pipelines? Any correlation with build tags? Can someone paste example log?
chris: Example log snippet:
```
2026-03-20T15:04:12Z iam AttachRolePolicy principal=svc-build-23 resource=arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/read-only
2026-03-20T15:04:13Z iam AttachRolePolicy principal=svc-deploy-7 resource=arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/admin
```
chris: note second line — admin role attached by svc-deploy-7
alex: svc-deploy-7 should not have admin. Initiating containment: disabling SA and kicking any active tokens. @riley can you run rotation?
riley: on it — disabling svc-deploy-7 now. running `aws iam update-login-profile --user svc-deploy-7 --password-reset-required` and revoking sessions, rotating keys.
sec-bot: action log: disabled principal svc-deploy-7 at 1968001455; triggered automated RBAC quarantine.
maria: I'm creating an allowlist for CI-tagged principals in SIEM to reduce FP. But we should be careful not to allow real escalations.
alex: Proposed SIEM tuning: require either requester IP != trusted-ci-range OR cross-account=true OR source=console for high-severity rule. Also add rate threshold per principal (e.g., >5 role-attach/min) and exclude known codebuild role patterns.
jordan: +1. Let's add a dashboard tile to show role-attach trends per principal and a 24h baseline.
chris: Post-incident tasks:
- rotate keys for any principal that did role changes
- update RBAC policy for svc-deploy-7
- add playbook step to verify commit hashes when CI principals escalate
- add SIEM suppression rules to ignore single attach events from codebuild
maria: I'll open a JIRA: SEC-1729 with those tasks and assign to infra and devex. Will include sample SIEM DSL and dashboard mock.
alex: FYI — we found one commit id that had a pipeline override flag. Starting vuln triage on that repo. If anything suspected, we'll notify CISO and legal per playbook.
riley: All done for now — svc-deploy-7 disabled, keys rotated. I'll update incident channel when done.
sec-bot: Incident closed (auto) pending manual review — incident id INC-1968001
alex: Thanks everyone. Follow-up sync at 16:00 to review dashboard and tuning. :thumbsup:
